cases.summary: Haddon's father is Marek Breck in order but Pol Breck in haddons-junction.

established.quote: His father. Marek Breck. Gallery engineer, thirty-one years.

contradicted.quote: Pol Breck would have looked. Pol Breck would have knelt beside this manifold housing

after.quote: Marek Breck would have looked. Marek Breck would have knelt beside this manifold housing

cases.notes: Both Haddon scenes were drafted together in 4df2140 and disagreed from the start; the audit harmonized to new-h2. Label source is an AI continuity-verification pass, not the author. "Pol Breck" appears 3x in new-h1.

cases.summary: Haddon's father dies in a junction-coupling steam breach in order, but of a chronic steam-worker's cough in haddons-junction.

established.quote: Died in the tunnels when a junction coupling failed in the Ashward loop and the steam did what steam did to a man standing within six feet of a full-pressure breach.

contradicted.quote: thirty-one years in the deep sections before the cough took him
The cough had taken his lungs, and the institution had taken his reports

after.quote: thirty-one years in the deep sections before a junction coupling failed in the Ashward loop and the steam found him
The coupling had taken him in the Ashward loop

cases.notes: Same draft commit as the father-name case; split because the name and the cause of death are separate facts.

cases.summary: Haddon's wife is Lenna in order but Maren in haddons-junction.

established.quote: his wife, Lenna, had been sick for eight months in the fourth year of their marriage.

contradicted.quote: the gap between what the fund covered and what Maren needed was a number

after.quote: the gap between what the fund covered and what Lenna needed was a number

cases.notes: "Maren" appears 3x in new-h1.

cases.summary: Haddon's wife survives her illness in order but dies fourteen months later in haddons-junction.

established.quote: Lenna lived. The blood condition resolved. The debt did not.

contradicted.quote: Maren had lived another fourteen months before the condition took her anyway
Fourteen months. She had lived fourteen more months.

after.quote: Lenna had lived. The condition resolved. The debt did not.
She was alive. She did not know what the money cost. Haddon carried both.

cases.notes: Fate of the wife is a separate fact from her name; same draft commit.

cases.summary: Calla is small in new-s3 but tall in finest-cartographer.

established.quote: She was small, dark-haired, with the quietness of a woman who had learned to take up exactly as much space as her work required and no more.

contradicted.quote: Calla was first. Tall, composed, her survey journal already open.

after.quote: Calla was first. Small, composed, her survey journal already open.

cases.notes: new-s3 was cut in 0ab2499 and has no slug at HEAD, so its span uses the old id as scene. "Tall" dates from the decomposition commit feb670e; new-s3 was added in 4df2140.

cases.summary: blackout says the protocol was refined over eight descents, but the same scene calls this the seventh descent.

established.quote: The seventh descent was the last one she would complete intact.

contradicted.quote: Their protocol, refined over eight descents into something that felt less like procedure and more like a language.

after.quote: Their protocol, refined over seven descents into something that felt less like procedure and more like a language.

cases.notes: Introduced in d5a34c2 ("Execute scene-level revisions", the merge that created merged-ch12-sc02-03); not clearly a named Storyforge pass, so kind is unknown.

cases.summary: The eastern galleries were sealed fourteen years ago, but doreens-footnote says the pre-sealing surveys had been waiting twelve years.

established.quote: The galleries had been sealed fourteen years ago.
The eastern vents had been classified as dormant for fourteen years.

contradicted.quote: The surveys had been waiting for twelve years.

after.quote: The surveys had been waiting for fourteen years.

cases.notes: Medium: "waiting" for twelve years is not strictly impossible, but the surveys are the pre-sealing archive and "fourteen years" is used in 15+ scenes.

cases.summary: In order, Haddon has worked for the arrangement for sixteen years, but the arrangement's notes have come for nineteen.

established.quote: He had been doing work for the arrangement for sixteen years.

contradicted.quote: the same absence of identifying mark that all the notes had carried for nineteen years.

after.quote: the same absence of identifying mark that all the notes had carried for sixteen years.

cases.notes: Nineteen years is the sabotage span (the same scene: "The corridor the cutting teams had used for nineteen years"); the two spans were conflated.

cases.summary: sorayas-fifteen-years has Elias waiting at Soraya's house for Tessa to arrive, but someone-you-need-to-meet has Tessa find him at the Ashward Reach access point and walk him there.

established.quote: She found Elias at the Ashward Reach access point three hours after leaving the survey office

contradicted.quote: When Tessa arrived, they would open the box.

after.quote: He would go to meet her soon — the Ashward Reach access point, where she would find him, and they would walk here together.

cases.notes: Medium: the contradicted side is an expectation ("would"), not a narrated event.

cases.summary: After the Day 3 descent was cut, deliberate-collapse (Day 4) still says the last descent was "last night"; the previous descent is now on Day 2.

established.quote: They turned back without discussion.
timeline_day: 2
timeline_day: 4

contradicted.quote: They moved faster now. Last night had taught her the sealed galleries' rhythms
The polished stone began where they had turned back the night before

after.quote: They moved faster now. That first descent had taught her the sealed galleries' rhythms
The polished stone began where they had turned back two nights ago

cases.label_source: 29e9f63:scenes/scene-index.yaml: Part-one-continuity pass fixes (ch08-sc02 "Last night", "the night before")
cases.notes: The part-one-pacing pass (7990997) cut ch07-sc05 (Descent 2, Day 3 night), folded its polished-stone sighting into merged-ch06-sc04-05 (Day 2), and in the same commit wrote "Last night had taught her" and "turned back the night before" into ch08-sc02. Two of the timeline anchors are frontmatter lines. The bundled "three nights' depletion" fix was dropped as too weak.

cases.summary: twenty-two-years (Day 6) has Elias remember holding Tessa's face three hours ago; he first cups her face on Day 10.

established.quote: He cupped her face. Both hands. Palms against her jaw, fingers along her cheekbones
timeline_day: 10
Elias took her hand in both of his.

contradicted.quote: These hands had held her face three hours ago.

after.quote: These hands had pressed into her depleted palms three hours ago.

cases.notes: new-elias-part1 was written by the character-deepening revision pass (8b8a07a) and was then on Day 6, after the Day 5 hand-tending in ch11-sc03.

cases.summary: Cassiel is an alderman in weight-of-the-rim but the Governor's senior secretary in governors-response.

established.quote: Alderman Cassiel was watching, spectacles low on his nose, the quarterly projections spread before him.

contradicted.quote: Cassiel, his senior secretary — twenty years managing the Governor's correspondence

after.quote: Cassiel, his senior alderman — twenty years managing the eastern development accounts

cases.notes: The character-scene-polish pass (5bf89eb, on new-v2.md before the slug rename) expanded a bare "Cassiel." into the secretary description. Fixed by the integration-pacing-continuity pass.

cases.summary: In walking-the-eastern-development (Day 11 morning) Tessa thinks of Dorren's complicity; she first learns Dorren is implicated that evening in archivists-box.

established.quote: Dorren Hayle. Pressure Cartography. Eastern quadrant classification management.
Eleven years. Tessa had worked under Dorren for five of those eleven years.

contradicted.quote: That made her complicit. Different from Voss's complicity, different from Dorren's — but complicit.

after.quote: She climbed toward the rim overlook. The eastern district spread below, rooftops catching morning light

cases.label_source: cc0b5f0:working/annotations/2026-03-31-annotations.json: chapter-13 scene 1 "Different from Voss’s complicity, different from Dorren’s" ("does she even know that Dorren is complicit yet?")
cases.notes: Order from reference/scene-metadata.csv at 2962d2e: walking-the-eastern-development seq 35 (Day 11 morning), archivists-box seq 42 (Day 11 evening). The fix deleted the sentence; fix.after quotes the paragraph that now follows it.

cases.summary: Haddon has a wife, Lenna, and no daughter, but elias-disarms twice gives him a daughter who needs the clinic.

established.quote: He'd built the whole arrangement around Lenna.
Lenna sick in the fourth year of their marriage.

contradicted.quote: Days she could breathe. His daughter could breathe.
and he could not take it back, and his daughter still needed the clinic, and the pistol was on the floor.

after.quote: and he could not take it back, and Lenna still needed the clinic, and the pistol was on the floor.

cases.notes: Introduced and fixed the same morning (haddon-climax-expansion, then continuity-integration-sweep). "His daughter could breathe." was deleted. Residue: "Lenna still needed the clinic" sits uneasily with order's "Lenna lived. The debt did not resolve."

cases.summary: routine-maintenance has a Block Fifteen foundation crew but puts the stone-cutters outside Voss's window on Block Fourteen; Block Fifteen is the active construction site.

established.quote: a progress summary from Block Fifteen's foundation crew
Block Fifteen's foundation work was proceeding on schedule.

contradicted.quote: On Block Fourteen, visible through his office window, the stone-cutters were working the afternoon shift.

after.quote: On Block Fifteen, visible through his office window, the stone-cutters were working the afternoon shift.

cases.notes: The brief for routine-maintenance (extracted in f82ffe0) asks for "stone-cutters on Block Fourteen audible through the window", inherited from the voss-strengthening pass (8c18ae3), which first wrote stone-cutters on Block Fourteen into governors-response. The 6c74d09 fix left the brief unchanged and the f74aa12 redraft from briefs put Block Fourteen back. Medium: two blocks under construction is not impossible, but the fix commit treats it as an error.

cases.summary: At HEAD routine-maintenance again puts the stone-cutters on Block Fourteen, beside Block Fifteen foundation correspondence; Block Fifteen is the construction site everywhere else.

established.quote: Correspondence from the Survey Council regarding the Block Fifteen foundation specifications.
The eastern crews would keep preparing Block Fifteen's foundations.

contradicted.quote: Outside the window, the stone-cutters on Block Fourteen were working.

cases.notes: Regression of governor-block-fourteen: the brief still carried "stone-cutters on Block Fourteen", and the redraft from corrected briefs (f74aa12) wrote it back, along with brief-checklist lines that naturalness-cleanup (fd45c62) later stripped.

cases.summary: The blackout progression is four, eleven, thirty seconds, but confrontation-at-stairwell-nine gives eleven seconds then seventeen.

established.quote: Four seconds. Then eleven. Then thirty.
Four seconds. Eleven. Thirty.

contradicted.quote: "Eleven seconds, four days ago. You lost motor control in your left hand for six seconds after you came back. You didn't report it."
"Seventeen seconds. Two days ago. Your breathing stopped for three of them. I counted."

after.quote: "Four seconds, three days ago. You were standing at the column access. You didn't report it."
"Eleven seconds. Two days ago. Your breathing stopped for three of them. I counted."

cases.notes: Introduced by "Revision: redraft 39 scenes from corrected briefs" and caught the same evening by the integration-sweep pass.

cases.summary: Tam Erdel is seven in haddons-reckoning but nine in acceptable-losses.

established.quote: Tam Erdel. Seven. Ground floor, same building.

contradicted.quote: An elderly woman, seventy-three. A child, nine.
Tam Erdel. Nine years old.

after.quote: An elderly woman, seventy-three. A child, seven.
Tam Erdel. Seven years old.

cases.notes: acceptable-losses existed before the 2026-04-07 redraft from briefs; that run's first draft (a1782ad) had "Tam Erdel, age seventy-one" and its second (58df81e) wrote "nine". The same fix left the woman's age (seventy-three) against haddons-reckoning's sixty-eight; see governor-victim-age. "Nine years old" appears twice.

cases.summary: commission-testimony calls Tessa Merrin 'Cartographer Vael' and 'Tessa Vael'; Vael is Elias's surname.

established.quote: Tessa Merrin was unassigned.

contradicted.quote: I received Cartographer Vael's report on the eastern pressure anomaly.
I selected Tessa Vael for the eastern survey because her Calibration sensitivity would confirm what I already knew.

after.quote: I received Cartographer Merrin's report on the eastern pressure anomaly.
I selected Tessa Merrin for the eastern survey because her Calibration sensitivity would confirm what I already knew.

cases.summary: Tessa carries second-degree burns on her left forearm from junction-fourteen onward, but the burns are Elias's from the Ashward Breach; Tessa is never burned on the page and is not in ashward-breach.

established.quote: His left forearm had blistered where the steam had found the gap between his glove and his sleeve.
Beneath the rolled sleeve, the burn scars began.

contradicted.quote: The burns on her left forearm still pulled when she flexed her fingers, the linen stiff with dried ointment.
Beneath the wrapping on her left forearm, the burns pulled when she flexed.

cases.notes: The hone pass d7e98f3 created burns-left-arm-tessa (acquired in ashward-breach) in physical-states.csv; 4befb51 (hone gaps) propagated it into physical_state_in on 80 briefs; the 2026-04-07 write redraft from briefs then wrote it into prose (first in 5a32223, footnote). Also in archivists-box, aftermath, everything-she-found, doreens-letter, counting-breaths and others. junction-fourteen is seq 7; ashward-breach (seq 4) is Elias's POV and does not mention Tessa.

cases.summary: physical-states.csv records the Ashward Breach burns as Tessa's, but ashward-breach gives them to Elias.

established.quote: His left forearm had blistered where the steam had found the gap between his glove and his sleeve.

contradicted.quote: burns-left-arm-tessa|tessa-merrin|Second-degree burns left forearm to shoulder with linen wrapping|injury|ashward-breach|never|true

cases.notes: At d7e98f3~1 ashward-breach read "Elias Vael, senior gallery engineer (reporting). Second-degree burns, left forearm to shoulder." The CSV row is the cause of governor-tessa-burns. physical-states.csv attributes 73 of 98 states to tessa-merrin; dust-on-knees-and-sleeves-tessa (acquired in weight-of-the-rim, a Voss scene) looks like the same misattribution but was not labeled.

cases.summary: article-twelve says the sabotage, nineteen years old, began before Block Fifteen's foundations were poured; terrace-row has crews still preparing those foundations now.

established.quote: The eastern crews would keep preparing Block Fifteen's foundations.
Eastern pre-construction survey teams to remain on Block Fifteen foundation work per existing schedule.

contradicted.quote: Nineteen years. The sabotage had begun before Block Fifteen's foundations were poured.

cases.notes: article-twelve (new-v4) was redrafted from briefs on 2026-04-07; f563ccf wrote this line. Block Fifteen has been the upcoming foundation work since the March Voss scenes.

cases.summary: Sera Holdt is one of the two Fenwick Row dead in haddons-reckoning and the-governors-vigil, but in acceptable-losses she is alive and working in Voss's office.

established.quote: Sera Holdt. Sixty-eight. Upper floors, the building adjacent to the junction housing. The pressure wave took out her wall.
Sera Holdt. First floor, nine years.

contradicted.quote: The casualty report was waiting on his desk when he returned, centered on the blotter where Sera Holdt had placed it.
Sera Holdt finished her count and turned from the cabinet.

cases.notes: Sera Holdt was the dead woman from her first appearance (965ba73, crisis-sequence). The 2026-04-07 redraft of acceptable-losses (a1782ad) reused her name for Voss's clerk; the same scene's casualty list leaves the dead woman unnamed.

cases.summary: The elderly Fenwick Row victim is seventy-three in acceptable-losses but Sera Holdt, sixty-eight, in haddons-reckoning.

established.quote: Sera Holdt, sixty-eight. Upper floors.

contradicted.quote: An elderly woman, seventy-three. A child, seven.

cases.notes: 240f2e5 fixed the child's age in the same sentence and left the woman's. Medium only because acceptable-losses does not name her; both scenes list the same two dead (an elderly woman and the child Tam Erdel).

cases.summary: Sera Holdt lived on the first floor in the-governors-vigil but on the upper floors in haddons-reckoning.

established.quote: Sera Holdt. First floor, nine years.

contradicted.quote: Sera Holdt, sixty-eight. Upper floors.

cases.notes: The original canon (965ba73) put her in unit 1 on the ground floor; the 2026-04-07 redraft of haddons-reckoning (abd762e) moved her upstairs. Medium because "first floor" can mean the ground floor; either way it is not "upper floors".

cases.summary: Tam Erdel was on the ground floor in haddons-reckoning but the second floor in the-governors-vigil.

established.quote: Tam Erdel. Seven. Ground floor, same building. He was in the corridor when the floor buckled.

contradicted.quote: Tam Erdel. Second floor, fourteen years.

cases.notes: The vigil list came from the redraft from corrected briefs (f74aa12); before it, the vigil named Devra Erdel on the fourth floor. Original canon (965ba73) had Tam in unit 2 on the ground floor. "Fourteen years" for a seven-year-old is probably the family's tenancy and was not labeled.

cases.summary: The thirty-second blackout happens at the column in blackout and confrontation-at-stairwell-nine, but elias-agrees-to-the-terms places it at Fenwick Row.

established.quote: Thirty seconds. The one from last night, in the eastern gallery, when she'd gone down to the column interface
"You went rigid. Eyes open. No response. Thirty seconds."

contradicted.quote: Thirty at Fenwick Row, when she'd gone so still he'd reached for the gauge on her wrist before she came back.

cases.notes: Fenwick Row South is the residential block of the rupture, not a descent site. Introduced by the 2026-04-07 redraft of elias-agrees-to-the-terms.

cases.summary: order gives Marek Breck thirty years in the galleries and, a page later, forty-eight years of work on the junction collars.

established.quote: the way a man walked who'd spent thirty years in galleries

contradicted.quote: Marek Breck had learned his tools on the Ashward junction collars. Forty-eight years of honest work.

cases.notes: Both phrases arrived in the same rewrite (a3ca495). Low: forty-eight years of work and thirty in the galleries can be reconciled; the earlier canon was "thirty-one years". The related age drift (Haddon nineteen at his father's death in new-h2, twenty-three at HEAD) has no HEAD counterpart and was not labeled.
